nodes.label: Write Storage Value

nodes.label: SSTORE Complete
nodes.description: Storage updated, gas charged, refund recorded, PC incremented

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Storage Instructions: Gas Cost Model (EIP-2200/EIP-2929)
sub_graphs.description: Models the complex gas pricing for storage operations with warm/cold access and refund calculations

nodes.label: SLOAD Gas Calculation
nodes.description: Need to determine SLOAD gas cost

nodes.label: Check SLOAD Warm/Cold
nodes.description: Determine if slot is in access list

nodes.label: Charge Warm SLOAD Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_WARM_ACCESS (100 gas)

nodes.label: Charge Cold SLOAD Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_COLD_SLOAD (2100 gas)

nodes.label: SSTORE Gas Calculation
nodes.description: Need to determine SSTORE gas cost based on value transitions

nodes.label: Check SSTORE No-Op
nodes.description: Check if new value equals current value (no change)

nodes.label: Charge No-Op Gas
nodes.description: Charge only GAS_WARM_ACCESS for unchanged value

nodes.label: Check Storage SET
nodes.description: Check if original is zero and new is non-zero (fresh allocation)

nodes.label: Charge Storage SET Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_STORAGE_SET (20000 gas) for new storage allocation

nodes.label: Charge Storage UPDATE Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_STORAGE_UPDATE - GAS_COLD_SLOAD for modification

nodes.label: Calculate Clear Refund
nodes.description: Add GAS_STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND when non-zero becomes zero

nodes.label: Calculate Restore Refund
nodes.description: Add refund when value is restored to original

nodes.label: TLOAD/TSTORE Gas Calculation
nodes.description: Transient storage uses uniform warm access cost

nodes.label: Charge Transient Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_WARM_ACCESS (100 gas) for all transient ops

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: Storage operation gas cost paid

external_entities.name: Caller Contract
external_entities.description: Contract that initiated the call, determines static context via STATICCALL

ambiguities.text: The interaction between SSTORE gas refunds and the 20% refund cap (EIP-3529) is not explicitly specified in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume refunds are accumulated but capped at execution layer to 20% of total gas used

ambiguities.text: Behavior when transient storage is accessed after transaction completion is not specified (should be impossible)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume transient storage is cleared atomically at transaction boundary and inaccessible afterward

implicit_assumptions.description: Access list state is correctly maintained across all SLOAD/SSTORE operations within a transaction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect warm/cold classification could lead to under- or over-charging gas, enabling DoS or economic attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: Original storage values are correctly snapshotted at transaction start for refund calculations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect refund calculations could drain gas or enable gas-based exploits

implicit_assumptions.description: The is_static flag is correctly propagated through call frames
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: State modifications could occur in contexts expected to be read-only, breaking STATICCALL guarantees

implicit_assumptions.description: Transient storage is properly isolated per (address, key) tuple within a transaction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cross-contract transient storage leakage could enable unexpected state sharing
